item.title: Good Morning From Siegfried
item.description: A new and sweet trist inn almost every morning, a bird I call Siegfried appears soon after I wake up and come downstairs. He stares at me for a while, and then eats a bite, and then stares again. I stare back. “Good morning, Siegried, I say. “He stares back, curious, or perhaps disbelieving.
